subject: SMT
disclaimer: NU Map is an independent, student-built planner. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data is scraped from Northeastern's public catalog and refreshed on a schedule; always confirm with the official catalog and an academic advisor.

legend.prereqs: Flat token list: course refs {subject, number, minGrade} joined by 'And'/'Or' strings; nested arrays are parenthesized groups. minGrade is the minimum passing grade required.
legend.coreqs: Courses that must be taken in the same term.
legend.offerings.terms: Past/scheduled terms by Banner code (YYYY = academic-year END year; Fall runs in YYYY-1). sections/enrolled/capacity are snapshots from the scheduled scrape, NOT live seat availability.
legend.offerings.typicalDays: Weekdays on which at least 50% of recent sections met.
legend.offerings.daysPct: Percent of recent sections meeting on each weekday (M/T/W/Th/F).
legend.offerings.meetingPatterns: [pattern, percent-of-sections] pairs; in patterns like 'MWR', R means Thursday.
legend.instructors: Per season. sharePct = average percent of that season's enrolled students taught by this professor (recent terms). 'reviews' links their RateMyHusky page when one exists.
legend.level: undergrad for course numbers below 5000, grad otherwise.
legend.typicallyOffered: Seasons in which the course was scheduled in at least two-thirds of that season's terms on record since it first appeared — a pattern, not a guarantee.
legend.unlocks: Courses that list this course in their prerequisites — what taking it opens up.
legend.nuPath: NUpath general-education attributes this course carries.
legend.repeatable: Whether the course may be taken more than once for credit (repeatMax / repeatMaxSH cap it).

courses.subject: SMT
courses.title: Building Business Acumen
courses.description: Offers students an opportunity to develop business acumen by examining how a business achieves its goals, studying how to assess the critical interdependencies across functions and divisions, and analyzing how financial and strategic decisions impact value creation. Emphasizes the short- and long-term trade-offs of business decisions; the role of marketing, sales, and customer service; and the tools to analyze and synthesize market and competitive data. Focuses on the assessment of key performance indicators that are most useful to appreciate the value of each customer to the organization.

courses.subject: SMT
courses.title: Managing the Customer Experience
courses.description: Offers students a framework for managing the customer experience in the digital era. Examines ways to influence every stage of the customer-decision journey, from lead generation to building long-term customer relationships. Engages students in the application of best practices in sales and service management in both the business-to-consumer (B2C) and business-to-business (B2B) sectors. Emphasizes ethical standards and trust in the customer engagement process.

courses.subject: SMT
courses.title: Decision Support and Sales Analytics
courses.description: Introduces current and emerging business analytical concepts and information technologies to support decision making and business intelligence for the sales industry. Discusses commercial decision support systems in various application areas using case studies, including CRM (customer relationship management), web analytics applications, sales force management systems, etc.

courses.subject: SMT
courses.title: Sales Management Capstone
courses.description: Offers students, working as individuals or in groups, an opportunity to design and carry out an interdisciplinary project conducted with real-world clients. Applies strategic frameworks and best practices to help organizations shift from seller-centric models to buyer-centric sales approaches.

courses.subject: SMT

courses.description: Covers special topics relevant to the sales management industry. May be repeated up to four times.
